newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian tourism slumps nearly five percent in H1.
newsitem.headline: Austrian tourism slumps nearly five percent in H1.

text.p: Austria's key tourism industry continued to slump in the first half of the year when the number of overnight stays dropped almost five percent to 52.76 million, according to government figures.
Overnight stays by foreign tourists fell 5.5 percent to 39.4 million in the first six months. Overnight stays by Austrian holiday-makers slipped 3.3 percent to 13.4 million.
Tourism turnover shed an estimated 0.7 percent, the ministry said. It gave no further details.
Income losses from tourism, traditionally a mainstay of Austria's economy, has contributed to the country's widening current account deficit, according to the central bank.

In the five months to the end of May, Austria's current account deficit increased to 21.4 billion schillings ($1.7 billion) from 17 billion the previous year. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254 ($ = 12.89 Austrian Schillings)
